caption: The drawing depicts a hexagonal, red wooden container with visible wood grain and some signs of wear and tear, including scratches and small chips in the paint. The container is vertically oriented and reinforced with three dark metal bands that wrap horizontally around its body. These bands are fastened with large, round, golden brass rivets visible at regular intervals. The top of the container features a metal fitting with a large curved handle, also painted in a dark color, attached with large brass fasteners; it curves up and outward at one end, while the other end has a flat leather strap fixed to the top with two rivets, forming a loop. The background is plain and beige, and the drawing is done on a textured paper. The artist's signature appears faintly in the lower right corner.
title: Lumberman's First Aid Kit
